library(ggplot2)

chart_data <- data.frame(
  x = c(0.01, 0.1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 10, 10, 100, 500, 800),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, log_x = log(x)/log(10))
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, .brks = list(pretty(log_x, 20)))
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, bin_log_x = .brks[[1]][findInterval(log_x, .brks[[1]], all.inside = TRUE)], bin_log_x_end = .brks[[1]][findInterval(log_x, .brks[[1]], all.inside = TRUE) + 1], .brks = NULL)

chart <- ggplot2::ggplot(chart_data)
chart <- chart + ggplot2::geom_rect(
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(
  xmin = (((x1) + (x2)) / 2) - ((((x2) - (x1)) / 2) * 0.9),

),
  stat = "count",
  ymin = -0.5,
  ymax = 0.5
) + ggplot2::theme(axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_blank())

# Generated by vl2ggplot::vegalite_to_ggplot(spec, chart_var = "chart", ignore_unsupported = FALSE, include_source_paths = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)

chart_data <- data.frame(
  country = c("Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "Great Britain", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States", "United States"),
  animal = c("pigs", "pigs", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "pigs", "pigs", "pigs", "pigs", "pigs", "pigs", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "cattle", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep", "sheep"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, emoji = {'cattle': '🐄', 'pigs': '🐖', 'sheep': '🐏'}[animal])
chart_data <- dplyr::group_by(chart_data, country, animal)
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, .win_rn = dplyr::row_number(), .win_tie = dplyr::consecutive_id(dplyr::row_number()))
chart_data <- dplyr::group_by(chart_data, country, animal, .win_tie)
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, .win_rank = min(.win_rn))
chart_data <- dplyr::group_by(chart_data, country, animal)
chart_data <- dplyr::mutate(chart_data, rank = .win_rank)
chart_data <- dplyr::select(chart_data, -.win_rn, -.win_tie)
chart_data <- dplyr::ungroup(chart_data)
chart <- ggplot2::ggplot(chart_data)
chart <- chart + ggplot2::geom_text(
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = factor(rank), y = factor(animal), label = factor(emoji)),
  size = 65
)
# NOTE: width/height are set when saving/displaying, e.g. ggsave(..., width = 800, height = 200)
chart <- chart + ggplot2::facet_grid(rows = dplyr::vars(country))


chart

# Generated by vl2ggplot::vegalite_to_ggplot(spec, chart_var = "chart", ignore_unsupported = FALSE, include_source_paths = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
# NOTE: this script depends on helper functions from the vl2ggplot package itself
# (vl_pivot()/vl_truthy()/... -- see R/runtime.R); it is not a standalone ggplot2 script.
library(vl2ggplot)

layer_data <- data.frame(
  year = c("1875", "1890", "1910", "1925", "1933", "1939", "1946", "1950", "1964", "1971", "1981", "1985", "1989", "1990", "1991", "1992", "1993", "1994", "1995", "1996", "1997", "1998", "1999", "2000", "2001", "2002", "2003", "2004", "2005", "2006", "2007", "2008", "2009", "2010", "2011", "2012", "2013", "2014"),
  population = c(1309, 1558, 4512, 8180, 15915, 24824, 28275, 29189, 29881, 26007, 24029, 23340, 22307, 22087, 22139, 22105, 22242, 22801, 24273, 25640, 27393, 29505, 32124, 33791, 35297, 36179, 36829, 37493, 38376, 39008, 39366, 39821, 40179, 40511, 40465, 40905, 41258, 41777),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)
chart <- ggplot2::ggplot(layer_data)
layer1_data <- data.frame(
  start = c("1933", "1948"),
  end = c("1945", "1989"),
  event = c("Nazi Rule", "GDR (East Germany)"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)
layer1_data <- dplyr::mutate(layer1_data, start = vl_parse_date(start), end = vl_parse_date(end))
layer1_data <- dplyr::mutate(layer1_data, year_start = as.Date(format(start, "%Y-01-01")), year_end = as.Date(format(end, "%Y-01-01")))
chart <- chart + ggplot2::geom_rect(
  data = layer1_data,
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(
  fill = factor(event),
  xmin = (((year_start) + (year_end)) / 2) - ((((year_end) - (year_start)) / 2) * 0.9),
  xmax = (((year_start) + (year_end)) / 2) + ((((year_end) - (year_start)) / 2) * 0.9)
),
  ymin = -Inf,
  ymax = Inf
)
layer2_data <- layer_data
layer2_data <- dplyr::mutate(layer2_data, year = vl_parse_date(year))
layer2_data <- dplyr::mutate(layer2_data, population = if (is.character(population)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(population)) else population)
layer2_data <- dplyr::mutate(layer2_data, .vl_gap_run = cumsum(is.na(year) | is.na(population)))
layer2_data <- dplyr::mutate(layer2_data, year_year = as.Date(format(year, "%Y-01-01")))
chart <- chart + ggplot2::geom_line(
  data = layer2_data,
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = year_year, y = population, group = .vl_gap_run),
  colour = "#333"
)
layer3_data <- layer_data
layer3_data <- dplyr::mutate(layer3_data, year = vl_parse_date(year))
layer3_data <- dplyr::mutate(layer3_data, population = if (is.character(population)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(population)) else population)
layer3_data <- dplyr::mutate(layer3_data, year_year = as.Date(format(year, "%Y-01-01")))
chart <- chart + ggplot2::geom_point(
  data = layer3_data,
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = year_year, y = population),
  colour = "#333"
)
# NOTE: width are set when saving/displaying, e.g. ggsave(..., width = 500)

# Generated by vl2ggplot::vegalite_to_ggplot(spec, chart_var = "chart", ignore_unsupported = FALSE, include_source_paths = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
# NOTE: this script depends on helper functions from the vl2ggplot package itself
# (vl_pivot()/vl_truthy()/... -- see R/runtime.R); it is not a standalone ggplot2 script.
library(vl2ggplot)

chart <- ggplot2::ggplot()
layer1_data <- read.csv("data/seattle-weather.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
layer1_data <- dplyr::mutate(layer1_data, date = vl_parse_date(date))
layer1_data <- dplyr::mutate(layer1_data, month_date = as.Date(format(date, "2012-%m-01")))
chart <- chart + ggplot2::geom_col(
  data = layer1_data,
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = month_date, y = precipitation),
  stat = "summary",
  fun = "mean"
)
layer2_data <- data.frame(
  date = c("May 1, 2010"),
  date_end = c("July 15, 2010"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)
layer2_data <- dplyr::mutate(layer2_data, date = vl_parse_date(date), date_end = vl_parse_date(date_end))
layer2_data <- dplyr::mutate(layer2_data, month_date = as.Date(format(date, "2012-%m-01")), month_date_end = as.Date(format(date_end, "2012-%m-01")))
chart <- chart + ggplot2::geom_rect(
  data = layer2_data,
  mapping = ggplot2::aes(
  xmin = (((month_date) + (month_date_end)) / 2) - ((((month_date_end) - (month_date)) / 2) * 0.9),
  xmax = (((month_date) + (month_date_end)) / 2) + ((((month_date_end) - (month_date)) / 2) * 0.9)
),
  fill = "grey",
  alpha = 0.5,
  ymin = -Inf,
  ymax = Inf
)
